subject: Initial discovery — coordinating AE/SE/eng + procurement/security availability
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasworks.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@atlasworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery — coordinating AE/SE/eng + procurement/security availability

Hi Samira — great to meet you over LinkedIn last week. Thanks for the intro and for being the champion here. I want to get a 45-minute discovery on the calendar so we can align on your use case, top success criteria, and any procurement/security constraints before a technical demo.

Attendees we usually bring for this: AE (me), Solutions Engineer (Ben), and either our Deployment Lead (Marissa) or Engineering Engagement if you'd like deeper infra coverage. I see from your notes Ethan is the engineering lead — would love to have him.

Proposed 45-min windows (all in PST):
- Thu, Oct 5 — 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Fri, Oct 6 — 9:30–10:15 AM PT
- Tue, Oct 10 — 11:00–11:45 AM PT

If procurement or security want to join a short chunk (10–15 mins) to capture requirements, we can leave the last 10 minutes as a Q&A slot. Otherwise we can follow up with a brief procurement sync.

If you send the best two windows that work for Ethan and procurement, I’ll lock it in and send an agenda + an optional calendar hold for security. I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and an example discovery agenda for context.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, Agenda-Discovery.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@atlasworks.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlasworks.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 18:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — coordinating AE/SE/eng + procurement/security availability

Hi Grace — thanks, this looks good. We are definitely interested. Two quick notes:
1) Ethan is available but has a calendar conflict on Oct 5 afternoon. He prefers the Oct 10 slot if possible.
2) Procurement asked to be looped up front — they prefer a short presence on the call and may request a commercial/term primer. I’ve CC'd procurement. Security intake will want the SOC details you attached; they may ask for evidence later.

Can you do Tue, Oct 10 at 11:00 AM PT? That should work for Ethan. If you could send a calendar invite with an agenda and the procurement primer, that would be ideal.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan | Head of AI Integrations, AtlasWorks
samira.k@atlasworks.com | +1 212-555-0822
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasworks.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — coordinating AE/SE/eng + procurement/security availability

Samira / Grace — quick technical note from my side. 45 minutes should be enough to map data flows and high-level infra constraints. For the discovery please confirm whether the engineers prefer:
- a) production-focused discussion (RD/throughput/latency targets) or
- b) proof-of-concept approach (pilot data, connectivity, PII concerns).

Either way, I’ll prepare a short runbook and a couple of screenshots of our model selection + deployment options. I’m based in PST; Oct 10 11:00 AM PT works for me.

Also attaching a short SOC2 summary here for security (SOC2-summary.pdf). If security requires evidence, please point me to an upload link or we can share via secure drive.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0233

Date: Thu, 05 Oct 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Discovery — Tue Oct 10 11:00 AM PT (calendar invite + agenda)

Thanks everyone — locking in Tue Oct 10 at 11:00 AM PT. I’ve created a calendar event and included a short agenda. If security wants to join the last 10–15 minutes, we’ll leave time.

Agenda (high level):
- 0–10m: intros & success criteria (Samira, Ethan)
- 10–35m: technical scoping (Ben, Marissa) — data flows, infra, pilot goals
- 35–45m: procurement / security Q&A (Procurement, Security)

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event?eid=AW-Discovery-1008
Drive (agenda + prep): https://drive.redwood.com/aw/Discovery/Agenda-20281003
DocuSign (optional NDA): https://docusign.com/NA/ABC-nda-123

Attachments: Agenda-Discovery.pdf

If Ethan or procurement need a different length (30 vs 45) let me know and we can compress. Mina — looping you for visibility on pricing/contract questions that may come up.

Best,
Grace

Thanks Grace — confirmed and calendar invite accepted. Ethan and I will attend; procurement will join for the first 10 minutes and security will hop on if they need to after reviewing the SOC summary. Forwarding the invite to our contract owner as well. Looking forward to the conversation.
